claim: The player velocity PLAXV is a 24-BIT accumulator — PLAXV RMB 3 — so its low byte (PLAXV+2) is a sub-pixel fraction; the value the camera slide consumes is the integer velocity PLAXV>>8. This is why the ship module keeps three bytes, not two.
The player vertical velocity PLAYV is 16-bit: PLAYV RMB 2. It is integrated into PLAY16 each frame with no post-add clamp.
PLADIR is the signed 16-bit 'THRUST+DIRECTION' vector: PLADIR RMB 2. Its sign is the ship's facing (positive right / negative left); thrust adds it into PLAXV.
NPLAD 'NEW PLAYER DIRECTION' (RMB 2) is the deferred facing REV writes; PLADIR is copied from it. Modelled as the flipped facing in stepReverse's result.
PLAY16 is the ship's 16-bit vertical position (RMB 2); the integer Y checked against the freeze limits is its HIGH byte (LDB PLAY16).
REVFLG is the REV switch DEBOUNCE latch (RMB 1): a held reverse button flips the facing exactly once because REV early-returns while REVFLG is set. Modelled as RevState.revflg.
PLADIR initialises to $0300 facing right — LDD #$0300 (stored into PLADIR on the next line) — the PLADIR_MAG the ship module thrusts by; facing left is its two's-complement negation.
Thrust is gated on the accel button — LDA PIA21 'ACCEL?' — read from the PIA; the shell owns the read and passes it in as the pure input snapshot's accel flag.
The accel button is PIA21 bit $02: BITA #$02. When set, PLADIR is added into the 24-bit PLAXV.
Thrust accumulates into the 24-bit velocity's low 16 bits: PL02 ADDD PLAXV+1 (the high byte then takes the sign-extended carry). accelX models the full 24-bit add.

X damping shifts the negated top-16 velocity LEFT by two (ASLB twice) — a ×4 — before adding it back into the low 16, so friction removes 4·(PLAXV>>8) per frame. This is the first of the two ASLB shifts.
X damping's second ASLB completes the ×4 (two left shifts) used by dampX: PLAXV -= 4·(PLAXV>>8).
Up motion freezes at the top of the strip: PLAUP CMPB #YMIN+1 — the integer Y is compared against YMIN+1 (=43, YMIN=42) and the following BLS returns without moving. Y_TOP_FREEZE.
While already rising the ship accelerates upward by 8 per frame: ADDD #-8. VY_STEP.
Upward speed clamps at $200: CMPD #-$200 (the following BGE keeps values ≥ -$200, else it loads -$200). VY_MAX.
Starting an upward move (or reversing from downward) kicks the vertical velocity to -$100: PLAUP1 LDD #-$100. VY_KICK.
Down motion freezes at the bottom of the strip: PLADN CMPB #238 — the integer Y is compared against 238 and the following BHS returns without moving. Y_BOTTOM_FREEZE.
While already descending the ship accelerates downward by 8 per frame: ADDD #8 (the mirror of the upward -8). VY_STEP.
Downward speed clamps at $200: CMPD #$200 (the following BLS keeps values ≤ $200, else it loads $200). VY_MAX.
Starting a downward move (or reversing from upward) kicks the vertical velocity to +$100: PLADN1 LDD #$100. VY_KICK.
REV is debounced by REVFLG: REV LDA REVFLG (the next line BNE REVX bails while the latch is set) — so holding reverse flips the facing exactly once, not every frame.
On the one flip, REV sets the latch: INC REVFLG — cleared only after the reverse button is released. stepReverse latches revflg=true on the flip and clears it on release.
The flip is a two's-complement negation of PLADIR: LDD PLADIR (followed by COMB/COMA/ADDD #1) negates the facing vector. Modelled as pladir('left') = −pladir('right').
